amends: the warm-start teacher: it gains a forward-swing phase (supersedes amendments 5, 6 and 7 on the teacher, not on acceptance); acceptance criteria unchanged
when: after the Jacobian-teacher run, before the next training run

evidence.jac_teacher_run: the two phase teacher passes the task on all six legs by itself, yet the trained network passed LF, RF and RM and failed the other three; LH and RH failed on exactly one criterion with advance = 0.0000, not on lift, placement or safety
evidence.why: the raise direction is the vertical Jacobian alone, so a rear leg's foot goes straight up and its forward displacement over the whole episode is exactly zero. A step is raise, carry forward, put down; the teacher only had the first and the third phase
evidence.teacher_self_check: DEMO_STEP_TEACHER.json: adding a swing phase taken from the horizontal Jacobian, with half of the raise kept in to hold height, gives a demonstration that passes all five criteria on ALL SIX legs. The best configuration is lift 60 ticks, swing 90 ticks, hold 0.5, then lower: rise 0.038-0.892, advance 0.587-0.980, final load 0.253-0.654

teacher_changes.phase_1: raise: vertical Jacobian ascent at the current pose, 60 ticks
teacher_changes.phase_2: new: swing forward along the horizontal Jacobian at the current pose, plus half the raise command, 90 ticks
teacher_changes.phase_3: lower: vertical Jacobian descent until the end of the window
teacher_changes.schedule: the teacher keeps a fixed schedule. The network that imitates it receives no clock, no phase input and no teacher at evaluation time.

unchanged.reward: achievement-flag potential with aligned swing gates

preregistered_outcomes: the teacher now passes on six of six, so every remaining failure is an imitation or optimisation result, not a feasibility statement
a network that reproduces four or more legs without any clock input is the strongest single-leg result so far and must still be labelled replacement ANN in a derived world
a network that keeps failing specific legs must be reported per leg with the criteria it does meet
discipline: every earlier preregistration and amendment is left byte-identical. The teacher is a declared rule-based demonstration; nothing here is a learned result until the network run reports it.
